item.text: The combined competing reference FASTA is ready and starts with the expected human UniProt records. I’m staging it into the same assigned Galaxy history before launching PepQuery2.

I’m going to launch PepQuery2 once per MGF against the combined human+cRAP database. Each run uses novel validation, the supplied candidate list, 10 ppm precursor tolerance, 0.6 Da fragment tolerance, trypsin with two missed cleavages, charges 2-6, CID/HCD, fixed C carbamidomethyl plus TMT11 on K and peptide N-terminus, and variable M oxidation.

The first submission was not sent because the wrapper’s pre-submit parameter checker could not resolve the nested section values. I’m checking the captured schema/provenance and will submit only once the payload shape matches what Galaxy expects.
